gap_recovery_followup.reason: The bounded getter reads an existing EOA attempt and rejects mismatched key/kind, terminal/quarantined admission or halted chain; it is not dispatch authorization. Fixed recovery windows, owner-fenced cooldown reservations, 32 sequential calls, missing-gap stop, actual counter progress and unchanged unknown-response behavior are implementation regression obligations, not newly proved scheduling/liveness properties. dispatch_pipeline_followup.reason: Both new/recycled production paths first reserve signed borrowed wires as a batch, then authorize each wire in input order through immutable admission/wire validation and independent journal commit/mirror. Redis worker ownership is read on both sides of awaited authorization. One authorized network wait can overlap the next authorization; ordered bounded results retain ID association. Suppressed send is conservative non-delivery, not a new safety transition. Models do not represent whole-batch barriers, first-poll revocation, Tokio buffers/Arc/atomics, worker-owner reads, ordered responses, cancellation/draining mechanics, recycled preparation, concurrency/rate/fairness or throughput; no new theorem/configuration/refinement proof is claimed. Six new real Redis/SQLite/HTTP regressions verify these implementation cuts, including both actual entry points and real higher nonce4 around holes2/3. pr_review_oct11.reason: Journal mutations retain their owned task, serial lock and admission slot from health check through SQLite commit, Redis CAS and postcheck. Blocking DB closures separately retain the file owner. Caller cancellation grants no permission and performs no chain send; OS/runtime crash still exposes the old fail-closed checkpoint gap. DisasterRecovery now models unavailable observation as a distinct halt that offline reattach may clear only with the exact authority token; primary role remains a runtime obligation. Other halt causes and chain/terminal conflicts stay non-clearable. Solana serialized admission/preflight uses processed while status/receipt evidence remains finalized; a missing pre-sign hash retries with unchanged serialized input, and simulation errors never imply global non-execution. Existing identity models abstract this admission filter and same-wire retries; parked attempts issue nonterminal NACK notifications through the owner-fenced completion pipeline without releasing identity. Supplied-gas EVM estimation filters invalid envelopes before signing without altering gas; intentional execution reverts remain valid. Redis pool reconnect only precedes WATCH and never retries EXEC. SIGTERM enters existing shutdown; webhook admission policy/read-only route exceptions do not authorize mutation. Concrete task lifetimes, signals, webhooks, node fee/gas/capability policies, JSON numeric precision, redaction, connection timings, and throughput remain implementation tests/review obligations, not model theorems. Final shutdown review adds a read-guard registration before spawning each mutation and an explicit write-barrier drain after all HTTP/workers finish; a regression covers unpolled registration and canceled commit-to-mirror work. This prevents orderly runtime shutdown from aborting detached publication, without changing forced-crash model transitions.

queue_shutdown_oct12.status: Source cancellation boundaries reviewed; executable validation is recorded separately. No model action or configuration changed.
queue_shutdown_oct12.reason: Single and multilane worker loops prioritize shutdown and observe it while awaiting Redis pop or error backoff. Cancellation before Lua applies stutters over QueueLease; an applied pop with an unseen reply maps to Poll then stuttering, retaining its lease until Expire and a later Poll. Shutdown does not create a completion, dispatch the unseen job, or cancel active handlers or their lease-fenced completion. WATCH/EXISTS/EXEC and journal ownership/drain are unchanged. Real-Redis tests withhold applied pop replies in both queue types, require bounded shutdown, then reclaim the original job through explicit lease expiry and observe one successful hook. A separate gated handler checks active work still drains through acknowledgement. Redis reconnect timing, response loss, Tokio cancellation, wall-clock shutdown bounds and liveness remain implementation obligations, not finite-model theorems. The active-job log count correction is diagnostic only.

health_capacity_fairness_oct12.reason: Health checks acquire their bounded chain lane cancellably before reserving one of32 global health slots. Only after both permits are held does run_owned register and spawn. The owned operation consumes that same lane in serial_guard_with_lane, retaining both permits through any pending checkpoint repair, FULL acknowledgement and final observation. Cancellation before registration grants no permission and releases acquired permits; after registration the existing drain barrier retains work. Authority transactions, Redis CAS, acknowledgement, finality and send gates are unchanged, so protocol actions are unchanged. Real Redis tests reject hot-chain slot monopolization, bound detached operations across distinct lanes, and check cancellation/drain at both admission boundaries. FIFO ordering, Tokio scheduling and performance remain implementation obligations, not a new finite-model liveness proof.
